entities.summary: Hayden Randle Hurst is an American former professional football player who was a tight end for seven seasons in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the South Carolina Gamecocks and was selected by the Baltimore Ravens in the first round of the 2018 NFL draft. Hurst also played for the Atlanta Falcons, Cincinnati Bengals, Carolina Panthers, and Los Angeles Chargers.
